licenses.text:
Lutherbibel 1912, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/deu1912/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/deu1912/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in German, Luther 1912
> Public Domain
> Language: Deutsch (German, Standard)
> Translation by: Martin Luther
> 2025-12-29

Why this is public domain:
Translator: Martin Luther, 1483-1546. Text: the second official church revision of the Luther Bible (New Testament December 1912, whole Bible 1913), unchanged until 1956. Its revisers were "a commission of theological experts", named in no source found; the 1922 Berlin printing's title page names only a church body ("Neu durchgesehen nach dem vom Deutschen Evangelischen Kirchenausschuß genehmigten Text"). eBible's Genesis 1 matches a 1912 transcription. US: published 1912-1913, before 1931. The maintainer's rule (2026-10-16): a text revised by an unnamed committee or reviser and published before 1926 is an anonymous work, in the public domain everywhere.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=deu1912), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/deu1912/copyright.htm), https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lutherbibel; https://archive.org/details/diebibeloderdie00luth; https://archive.org/details/Die-Bibel_1912; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
